questions.question: Choose the correct form of the verb to complete the sentence: 'I wish I _____ more time to practice my English.'
Which sentence correctly uses the present perfect continuous tense?
options: She has lived here for five years.
She has been living here for five years.
She lives here for five years.
She was living here for five years.
questions.answer: She has been living here for five years.

questions.question: Select the correct option to complete the sentence: 'If I _____ you were coming, I would have cleaned my room.'
Which modal verb is used to express possibility in the past?
Choose the correct comparative form: 'The film was _____ interesting than the book.'
Which sentence correctly uses the gerund or infinitive after the verb 'decide'?
options: I decided to go to the cinema.
I decided go to the cinema.
I decided of going to the cinema.
I decided for going to the cinema.
questions.answer: I decided to go to the cinema.

questions.question: Select the correct option to complete the sentence: 'By the time I arrived, the meeting _____.'
Which sentence correctly uses the third conditional?
options: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
If I studied harder, I would pass the exam.
If I had studied harder, I would pass the exam.
If I study harder, I would have passed the exam.
questions.answer: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.

questions.question: Choose the correct option to complete the sentence: 'I enjoy _____ in the garden in the morning.'
Which sentence uses the correct linker to compare two things?
options: The movie was interesting, but the ending was disappointing.
The movie was interesting, however the ending was disappointing.
The movie was interesting, whereas the ending was disappointing.
The movie was interesting, moreover the ending was disappointing.
questions.answer: The movie was interesting, but the ending was disappointing.
